people.name: Azariah
people.line: One of Daniel's companions, survived the fiery furnace

people.name: Hananiah
people.line: One of Daniel's three friends in Babylon.

people.name: Mishael
people.line: A Jewish exile in Babylon, friend of Daniel.

people.name: Nebuchadnezzar
people.line: Emperor of Babylon who conquered Judah

translations.web: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego answered the king, “Nebuchadnezzar, we have no need to answer you in this matter.
translations.bsb: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego replied to the king, “O Nebuchadnezzar, we have no need to answer you in this matter.
translations.kjv: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, answered and said to the king, O Nebuchadnezzar, we are not careful to answer thee in this matter.
translations.asv: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego answered and said to the king, O Nebuchadnezzar, we have no need to answer thee in this matter.
